_comment: Player-facing change notes for every listed patch of the pre-Reforged runes page (runes.html), shown by the patch-notes control next to the Patch dropdown. Hand-curated from data/patches/runes.json (changes, notes, sources) and the research behind it: every bullet is backed by that data, nothing is added.

patches: { <patch as in the listing>: { summary, items, kind } }. summary: one line, at most 90 characters, ending in " (approx.)" when the listing's confidence is low. items: short bullets, old → new values, at most about 8. kind: launch | rework | change | season-start | season-end | no-change; a season boundary without a rune change is no-change, and its count in the registry is 0.
tools/build-notes.js checks this file against the listing and writes data/notes/runes-<season>.js (one LolData.register("notes", ...) per season).

V1.0.0.63.summary: Earliest rune values on this page; Snowdown 2009 runes (approx.)
items: The rune page starts here: earlier rune values are not known (the patch notes before it give only percentage changes)
This patch: attack damage per level runes +11.1%, attack speed runes +150%, magic penetration runes +13.6%, flat health runes −17.6%, armor and magic resist runes (also per level) −10%
Clarity seals become obtainable
2009 Snowdown event runes (December 16, 2009 – January 6, 2010): Crippling Candy Cane, Yuletide Tannenbaum, Elusive Snowflake (dodge), Stout Snowman, Special Stocking, Gracious Gift

V1.0.0.72.summary: Critical damage runes −10%, flat ability power +10%; Winter Games runes
items: Critical damage runes −10%: Greater Mark of Furor +2.48% → +2.23%, Greater Quintessence of Furor +4.96% → +4.46%
Flat ability power runes +10%: Greater Glyph of Potency +0.9 → +0.99, Greater Quintessence of Potency +4.5 → +4.95
2010 Winter Games event runes (February 12 – March 2, 2010): Alpine Alacrity, Combatant, Medalist, Extreme (dodge), Challenger, Soaring Slalom

V1.0.0.94(b).summary: Energy runes added: Meditation, Lucidity, Acumen and Sapience
items: Energy runes added: Meditation and Lucidity seals, Acumen and Sapience glyphs, Meditation and Acumen quintessences
Greater Quintessence of Acumen +4.9 Energy; Greater Quintessence of Meditation +1.5 Energy regen per 5s
Season One starts with V1.0.0.96 (July 13, 2010), with these same runes

Attack damage per level (Might) marks, glyphs and seals +35%: Greater Mark of Might +1.8 → +2.43 at level 18
Armor penetration (Desolation) marks and quintessences −15%: Greater Mark 1.96 → 1.66, Greater Quintessence 3.91 → 3.33
Limited 2010 Harrowing quintessences: Piercing Screech, Bountiful Treats, Speedy Specter, Elusive Werewolf (dodge), Witches Brew, Headless Horseman

items: Event rune only: Quintessence of the Headless Horseman 3.62 → 3.08 armor penetration

V1.0.0.131.summary: New rune types: Destruction, Avarice, Endurance, Vampirism, Transmutation
items: New rune types: Destruction (armor and magic penetration marks and quintessences), Avarice seals (gold per 10s), Endurance (% health seals and quintessences), Vampirism (life steal quintessences), Transmutation (spell vamp quintessences)
Tier 3 values: Greater Quintessence of Destruction +2 armor / +1.3 magic penetration, Greater Quintessence of Vampirism +2% life steal, Greater Seal of Avarice +0.25 gold per 10s

V1.0.0.152.summary: Season 3: runes renamed after their stat; penetration runes rebalanced
items: Runes renamed after their stat, for example Mark of Desolation → Mark of Armor Penetration, Glyph of Potency → Glyph of Ability Power
Armor penetration: Greater Mark 1.66 → 1.28, Greater Quintessence 3.33 → 2.56
Magic penetration: Greater Mark 0.95 → 0.87, Greater Glyph 0.68 → 0.63, Greater Quintessence 2.18 → 2.01
Hybrid Penetration (was Destruction): Greater Mark 1 / 0.57 → 0.9 / 0.61, Greater Quintessence 2 / 1.3 → 1.79 / 1.4
Event quintessences follow: Headless Horseman 3.08 → 2.37, Deadly Wreath 3.33 → 2.56, Piercing Present 2.18 → 2.01
Tooltip only: Greater Mark of Hybrid Penetration says +0.62 magic penetration; the stat and the patch notes give 0.61 (the tooltip keeps it until V7.21)

V6.22.summary: Preseason 7: armor penetration runes become Lethality (×1.25)

Marks and Quintessences of Armor Penetration become Lethality: Greater Mark 1.28 → 1.6, Greater Quintessence 2.56 → 3.2
Hybrid Penetration becomes Precision: Greater Mark 0.9 → 1.13 Lethality, Greater Quintessence 1.79 → 2.24 Lethality (magic penetration unchanged)
The Headless Horseman and Deadly Wreath quintessences move to Lethality
Mark of Precision (tier 2): +0.88 Lethality in game (Riot's published rune stats still said +0.7)
